QuestInfo.name: Check Yourself 2
QuestInfo.0: That's it for the movement tests. Ask Jay if there's any more boring stuff left.
QuestInfo.1: Time to see how long it takes you to recover from training. Have a drink and take a rest before getting back to Jay.
QuestInfo.2: Recover HP by drinking potions or beverages from your inventory. You can bind them to hotkeys to use them as well. Now that your health has recovered, ask Jay what to do next. \r\n

1.0: Geez, you rebounded from your training super fast. I don't understand how you're in such good shape.

item.0: Seriously dude, drink that thing. I need to scan how it works through your system. And don't visualize how that's going to work.
